잠언 1:1.content: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

잠언 1:2.content: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;

잠언 1:3.content: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;

잠언 1:4.content: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.

잠언 1:5.content: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:

잠언 1:6.content: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

잠언 1:7.content: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

잠언 1:8.content: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

잠언 1:9.content: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.

잠언 1:10.content: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.

잠언 1:11.content: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:

잠언 1:12.content: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:

잠언 1:13.content: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:

잠언 1:14.content: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:

잠언 1:15.content: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:

잠언 1:16.content: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.

잠언 1:17.content: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.

잠언 1:18.content: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.

잠언 1:19.content: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

잠언 1:20.content: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:

잠언 1:21.content: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,

잠언 1:22.content: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?

잠언 1:23.content: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.

잠언 1:24.content: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;

잠언 1:25.content: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:

잠언 1:26.content: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;

잠언 1:27.content: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.

잠언 1:28.content: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:

잠언 1:29.content: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the Lord:

잠언 1:30.content: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.

잠언 1:31.content: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.

잠언 1:32.content: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.

잠언 1:33.content: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
